properties.name: app.state.store
properties.description: Where cross-replica state (JWT denylist, failed-login counters, cache-load lease) lives: 'memory' keeps it in this JVM, 'redis' shares it through Redis with the in-memory implementations as fallback. Read by core.SharedStateStore and a @ConditionalOnProperty.

properties.name: app.security.require-strong-admin-password
properties.description: Refuse to start with a missing, development-default or placeholder admin password (auth.AdminPasswordGuard, created only when this is true).

properties.name: app.logging.async.max-flush-time-ms
properties.description: Longest time the async log appender may take to flush on shutdown (read by logback-spring.xml).
